SafeMath.sub(a,b): delegates to sub(a,b,errorMessage).

SafeMath.mul: returns a * b, reverting on overflow.
SafeMath.div(a,b): delegates to div(a,b,errorMessage).

Timelock constructor: sets admin = msg.sender, delay = MINIMUM_DELAY, admin_initialized = false.
Payable fallback function accepting plain ETH transfers.
setDelay(uint256): only callable by the Timelock itself, updates delay within bounds.
acceptAdmin(): pendingAdmin becomes admin and pendingAdmin is cleared.
setPendingAdmin(address): stages a new pendingAdmin; first call is unrestricted.
queueTransaction(address,uint256,string,bytes,uint256): admin-only queueing of a delayed transaction.
cancelTransaction(address,uint256,string,bytes,uint256): admin-only cancellation of a queued transaction.
executeTransaction(address,uint256,string,bytes,uint256): executes a queued transaction via a low-level call after delay.
getBlockTimestamp(): internal view returning block.timestamp.
msg.sender: caller identity used for all authorization checks and admin assignment.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time source used for timelock delay/expiry checks.
